title: Newmark Announces Launch of APEX Atlanta, a Rebranded Class A Office Campus in Atlanta’s Buckhead Submarket
summary: Newmark, in its capacity as exclusive leasing agent on behalf of ownership, Banyan Street Capital announces the launch of APEX Atlanta, a newly rebranded, three-building Class A office campus.
body_markdown: Newmark, in its capacity as exclusive leasing agent on behalf of ownership, Banyan Street Capital announces the launch of APEX Atlanta, a newly rebranded, three-building Class A office campus.
